title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 8287d65844b6… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 8287d65844b6b116dbd3ec838c362577aa33257c192eb8c1107bb190b1668d36 was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-14. This file was detected seven times in attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) originating from attacker infrastructure in the Netherlands. The file is associated with a malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. Organizations are advised to check this hash against their environments and security tools to detect potential compromise.
